title: Enhancing Hyperledger Fabric: A Scalable Framework for Optimized Blockchain Performance
venue: 27th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: Optimizes Hyperledger Fabric performance through tuning of system parameters including block size, endorsement policies, and consensus mechanisms. Establishes a network architecture with two organizations, three Raft orderers, and a distributed consensus mechanism, achieving significant gains in throughput, scalability, and responsiveness over default Hyperledger Fabric configurations.

title: A Blockchain-Based Scalable Framework for Academic Document Verification
venue: 26th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT)
abstract: A blockchain-based framework for verifying academic documents, using Ethereum smart contracts and cryptographic hashing to prevent modification, confirm authenticity, and ensure proper storage. Addresses widespread document forgery in academic contexts and demonstrates precise verification compared to existing centralized solutions.
